prompt:
Create one realistic cinematic portrait of this same fictional adult man at a clear three-quarter angle.
Image 1 is the authoritative reference for his identity, face, age, cold expression, short dark hair, pale gray-blue eyes and clothes. Image 2 shows his profile and is supporting reference ONLY for nose, lip and integrated chin geometry. Do not average the two expressions; preserve image 1's severe, self-contained scrutiny.

Face turned approximately 45 degrees toward image right, level head, normal upright neck. Show a broad near cheek and a genuinely narrow far cheek; the nose partially overlaps the far cheek, the far eye is foreshortened. This must be a substantial facial turn, not a frontal face on turned shoulders. The eye line is level, with his gaze fixed on a person out of frame along the direction of his face.

Carry the face and expression of image 1 into this view as faithfully as possible. His eyes are cold and steady under the same close-set brow and upper-lid relationship, with no questioning lift. He has the stillness of someone who holds authority and does not need to solicit a response. Mouth naturally closed and completely still, without a pout, a smile, lip compression, or a frown. Preserve his adult composure; do not make him look alert, listening for guidance, coy, sullen or innocent.

Match the actual lean cheek structure and proportions of image 1. Use image 2 to resolve the spatial relationship of nose, lips and chin. No swollen cheeks, pinched pointed lower face, square jutting chin block or protruding mouth. Preserve the source's lower-face length and natural lip volume.

Strong directional side light with a broad shadow on the far side of the face, maintaining the same dark sculptural atmosphere as image 1. The near eye remains visible without glowing. Desaturated pale gray-blue irises, natural skin texture. Dark jacket and black shirt, same dark interior, chest-up portrait. No text, collage or watermark.

use_limit: 只作为候选比较，不能因内部排序而升级为作者认可。单图不能证明精确三维角度或像素锁定。
